description: This file defines icon-related models, constants, and utility functions for handling SVG and material icons in the application, including icon categorization, searching, and resource loading.

classes.name: MaterialIcon
classes.description: Interface representing a material icon with name, optional displayName, and tags.

methods.name: splitIconName
methods.description: Splits an icon name into namespace and icon name parts based on colon separator.

methods.name: isSvgIcon
methods.description: Determines if a given icon string corresponds to an SVG icon based on namespace and icon name.

methods.name: iconByName
methods.description: Finds a MaterialIcon object in an array by its name.

methods.name: getMaterialIcons
methods.description: Loads and processes a list of material icons from a JSON resource, with optional search and chunking, returning an observable of icon chunks.
